items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: when we started our long musical association... we’re recording another album in May together... the duo

ctx.x: Well you know fugal music, classical fugal music is very similar to jazz. When one has a figured bass, one can improvise over a figured bass. And actually the way Bill Cunliffe and I have started our long — when we started our long musical association, and in fact © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

we’re recording another album in May together, I heard Bill in the years when I was booking the Hilton Grand here in San Diego. I heard Bill throw in a classical fugal section in the middle of a jazz tune one night, when he wasn’t even playing for me, it was with the Clayton Brothers. And I went, oh, oh there is somebody else that does it. I went running over to the piano and I said Bill would you like to come down and play with me? And he said well sure. I was so excited and it has become such a wonderful…
